div.div:
OIDC Endpoints
/.well-known/openid-configuration
/oauth2/authorize (login page + PKCE)
/oauth2/token (code exchange)
/oauth2/userinfo (profile)
/jwks.json (public keys)
/oauth2/revoke (token revocation)

Zero-Trust Security
ZeroTrustFilter validates JWT
on every request
- RS256 asymmetric signing
- Token revocation support
- Endpoint allowlist

Multi-Hash Password Validator
1. BCrypt (native)
2. SHA-256 + salt (Main Site legacy)
3. Plain MD5 (MA Site legacy)
→ Lazy upgrade to BCrypt on login
